verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents a permission system with Deny/Ask/Allow access lists, project-scoped permissions, permission adjustment via /config, and configurable MCP/plugin integrations, so a lead can shape what the agent reaches. The docs do not say these lists cover external tools or MCP integrations specifically, and community reports of a permissive default allowlist that was used to exfiltrate secrets point to weak defaults rather than a missing control. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that permissions govern external tools/MCP servers per tool, admin or team-level enforcement of integration policies, and independent hands-on corroboration that the controls hold.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access

citations.quote: Permissions are evaluated across three distinct access lists: Deny... Ask... Allow
support custom settings and scoped permissions
adjust permissions, themes, and preferences via /config
Access plugins, MCP, skills, and hooks configurations instantly via slash commands
